## R1: Divide
As a calc user, I want to divide two numbers, so that I can compute ratios.
- R1.1 WHEN divide(a, b) is called with b not equal to 0 THE SYSTEM SHALL return a divided by b
- R1.2 IF divide(a, b) is called with b equal to 0 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL throw a RangeError with the message "division by zero"

# Design

`divide.js` like `add.js`; throw RangeError on b === 0.

- [ ] T1: Add divide()
  - Requirements: R1.1, R1.2
  - Paths: divide.js, test/divide.test.js
  - Depends on: none

spec.text: Spec written: divide, and RangeError on zero.

input.content: export const divide = (a, b) => a / b;
